question: Which magazine was started first, Arthur's Magazine or First for Women?

title: Arthur's Magazine
First for Women
text: Arthur's Magazine (1844-1846) was an American literary periodical published in Philadelphia in the 19th century.
First for Women is a women's magazine published by Bauer Media Group in the USA.

question: The director of the film "The Graduate" also directed which other 1970 film starring Jack Nicholson?

title: The Graduate
Carnal Knowledge
text: The Graduate is a 1967 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Mike Nichols.
Carnal Knowledge is a 1971 American drama film directed by Mike Nichols and starring Jack Nicholson.

question: Which company, founded by the co-founder of LinkedIn, invested in the artificial intelligence company DeepMind?

title: Reid Hoffman
Greylock Partners
DeepMind
text: Reid Hoffman is an American internet entrepreneur, venture capitalist and author. He is the co-founder and former executive chairman of LinkedIn.
Reid Hoffman is a partner at the venture capital firm Greylock Partners.
DeepMind is a British artificial intelligence company founded in September 2010, and was acquired by Google in 2015. Greylock Partners invested in DeepMind.
